name: Tresorit
description: Tresorit is an end-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure collaboration platform for sensitive business files. Individuals and organizations use it to store and synchronize documents, share protected links, exchange files with clients, and control access to confidential content.
agentUseSummary: After Tresorit enables the customer's Early Adopter API, connect the customer's public HTTPS S3 gateway with its locally generated access key and secret, then let agents use the documented main-folder and file operations under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: TRESORIT_S3_ENDPOINT
credentialRequirements.label: Tresorit gateway URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the public HTTPS address of your Tresorit S3 gateway. The local default address cannot be reached by Relay Console.

credentialRequirements.name: TRESORIT_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Access key ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy client_id from the credentials generated by the Tresorit API setup.

credentialRequirements.name: TRESORIT_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Secret access key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy client_secret from the credentials generated by the Tresorit API setup.

capabilities.label: Read secure storage
capabilities.description: List main folders and files, inspect metadata, and download bounded files through the customer's Tresorit S3 gateway.

capabilities.label: Manage secure storage
capabilities.description: Create and delete main folders, upload files, and delete explicitly selected files through the customer's gateway.

allowed.label: List main folders
allowed.description: List a bounded page of Tresorit main folders exposed by the customer's gateway.

allowed.label: List files
allowed.description: List a bounded page of files in one main folder.

allowed.label: Download file
allowed.description: Download one file up to Relay's five-megabyte agent response limit.

approvalRequired.label: Create main folder
approvalRequired.description: Create one Tresorit main folder; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Delete main folder
approvalRequired.description: Delete one empty Tresorit main folder; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Upload file
approvalRequired.description: Upload one file up to five megabytes; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Delete file
approvalRequired.description: Delete one file; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Delete files
approvalRequired.description: Delete up to 100 explicitly named files; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Reach a private gateway
blocked.description: Railway cannot call localhost, loopback, link-local, or private-network gateway addresses.

blocked.label: Transfer an unbounded file
blocked.description: Relay limits agent upload and download payloads to five megabytes even though the provider gateway accepts larger single-part files.

blocked.label: Use an unsupported S3 operation
blocked.description: Multipart uploads, copy, move, rename, version history, empty subfolders, and hidden Tresorit areas are not supported by the current gateway API.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded main-folder, file-list, metadata, and download reads run directly; creation, upload, and deletion require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected gateway-authorized Tresorit operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, the configured HTTPS endpoint, bounds, auditing, redaction, gateway permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed SigV4 wrappers for the documented Tresorit gateway operations and never exposes gateway credentials to the agent.
Railway mounts typed SigV4 wrappers for the documented Tresorit gateway operations and never exposes gateway credentials to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Tresorit currently provides its S3-compatible API only through an Early Adopter waitlist, and no enabled customer gateway or generated credentials are available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Join Tresorit's Early Adopter waitlist, obtain API enablement, deploy the official gateway on customer-controlled infrastructure behind trusted public HTTPS, generate client_id and client_secret locally, connect them in Relay Console, then verify list, metadata, bounded download, Safe denial plus approval, Dangerous create/upload/delete, redaction, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Tresorit documents an Early Adopter waitlist, a customer-deployed Docker gateway, local encryption and decryption, locally generated S3 credentials, fixed us-east-1 SigV4 signing, and the supported bucket and object operations.

Tresorit's official repository documents customer-hosted deployment, required HTTPS, enabled-account access, supported file and main-folder operations, five-gigabyte single-part uploads, path-style addressing, and the current API limitations.
Tresorit describes its end-to-end encrypted cloud storage, protected file sharing, collaboration, access control, and business use cases.
